author: Arjun Menon
text: Morning team. Please check the datalogger readings on Chiller-01 before start of shift.

author: Dr. Meera Iyer
text: Arjun, did you see my email regarding the storage band adjustment?

author: Arjun Menon
text: Yes Dr. Iyer. I am updating the setpoints on the control panel right now.

author: Arjun Menon
text: Per Dr. Meera Iyer, hold vaccine batches at 2 to 6 °C until SOP-014 is revised.

author: Sana Khan
text: Got it Arjun. Has the building automation alarm threshold been updated as well?

author: Arjun Menon
text: Yes, high alarm warning is now configured at 6.1 °C on both units.

author: Vikram Shah
text: Are we ready to stage batch VAC-2026-902 for packaging?

author: Arjun Menon
text: Temp logs over the last 24 hours show stable 3.8 °C. Clear for transfer.

author: Sana Khan
text: Double check the probe calibration certificate before signing the transfer sheet.

author: Vikram Shah
text: Backup compressor routine test scheduled for 14:00 today.

author: Arjun Menon
text: Confirmed, I will monitor temperature telemetry throughout the switchover.
